quality_benchmark.scope: Four fixed exact-mask quality examples, not an automatic detection or universal quality benchmark.
quality_benchmark.native_photo_note: Two clean native crops from the original 1536x2048 image, 340x112 and 206x56; no background resizing. Synthetic watermark pixels are selected exactly.

metrics_note.unit: 8-bit RGB units; arithmetic mean over channels.
metrics_note.mask_mae: Mean absolute RGB error against known clean truth inside the exact contamination mask.
metrics_note.gradient_mae: Mean absolute error of forward RGB x/y differences on every edge touching the mask.
metrics_note.inner_boundary_mae: RGB MAE on the one-pixel inner mask boundary (4-neighbor erosion).
metrics_note.boundary_crossing_gradient_mae: Gradient error on edges with exactly one masked endpoint.
metrics_note.texture_hp_rms: RMS of Rec.709-luma minus Gaussian(sigma=1) inside the mask; a diagnostic only. A ratio near 1 does not establish texture phase or truth recovery.
metrics_note.scope: Output versus original marked pixels outside the mask. Zero proves scope, not restoration quality.
metrics_note.limitation: Small fixed backgrounds and known exact masks; this is a quality comparison, not a representative dataset or text-mask segmentation test.

quality_benchmark.review: All four final refinements improve over exemplar initialization on masked MAE. Compared with v1.2 consensus, three MAEs increase and one is effectively unchanged; all gradient and boundary errors increase. Native grain remains softened. These tradeoffs are retained rather than relabeled as accuracy gains.
quality_benchmark.rejected_internal_candidate: A hard donor-winner candidate caused a visibly interrupted native table edge and higher errors. It was withdrawn; final code uses observed-structure protection and overlapping means.

history.scope: Targeted detail fixes with small fixed quality examples; independent use also exposed unresolved ROI sensitivity and donor-support failure. No universal quality claim.

metric_definitions.masked_rgb_mae_0_255: Mean absolute RGB error across all three channels at mask==True, against clean truth. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.local_gradient_mae: Convert RGB uint8 to gray then float32; Sobel ksize=3 / 8 in x and y; average absolute error of those two components over mask dilated by one pixel. Matches original quality_lab evaluator. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.gradient_energy_ratio_on_mask: RMS gradient magnitude(output)/RMS gradient magnitude(truth), on mask. Descriptive only; near 1 does not prove correct texture.
metric_definitions.inner_mask_boundary_rgb_mae_0_255: RGB MAE on the one-pixel inner boundary of the exact mask. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.seconds: Single observed time.perf_counter elapsed; method call only. Refine increment excludes initial fill; end-to-end includes initial plus refinement. Not a statistically stable speed benchmark.
metric_definitions.alpha: Both algorithms accept only RGB. Original alpha is reattached by the comparison caller; alpha stability is a pipeline check, not native RGBA support in either function.

quality_benchmark.photo_case_note: Recreated exactly one existing benchmark photo case: original crop [x=95:700,y=1920:1970] resized to 512x256 with INTER_LINEAR, then synthetic TEST 01 watermark. Cropping/resizing limits realism; this is not an untouched native-resolution photo benchmark.
